{{cmavo|sei'u|UI|evidential UI, "seemingly, apparently" (< '''simlu''')}}
*[[User:And Rosta|And Rosta]]:
*: If we are to properly exploit UI, we need to add extra ones when they are as utile as the existing ones. The closest to '''sei'u''' is '''ja'o''' ("I conclude"), but '''sei'u''', like '''da'i''', entails '''ju'anai''' (''I do not state''). Whether '''ja'o ju'anai''' is an adequate substitute for '''sei'u''' remains to be seen.
*: '''sei'unai''' might mean ''contrary to appearances'', but this (to me at least) implies '''ju'aja'ai'''.
*[[la gleki]]:
*:de facto {{vlapoi|si'au} has been used in years 2015 - 2017.
